sections.text: Group the provided PresentationCues into cue-bound semantic segments and describe them. PresentationCues supply semantic content; every formal claim and every segment title must cite one or more NormalizedCue identities.
Propose segment boundaries only between existing PresentationCues within one Part. Never invent a time split, a cross-Part segment, or a theme boundary without cited evidence.

Each PresentationCue is provided verbatim as its NormalizedCue identity followed by its exact recognized text, in Part order. Do not use external knowledge, translation, unit conversion, or entity inference.

Return a single JSON object matching the versioned output schema exactly as specified in the output-contract section below, including the fixed schema_version, output_schema_version, and adapter_identity values. Every segment boundary and every cited claim must reference a NormalizedCue identity from the provided cues. Prose defaults to Chinese; cited source text retains its original language.
